mapper.sql: c.id, c.conversation_type, c.queue_code, c.customer_id, c.assigned_staff_id, c.status, c.last_seq, p.last_read_seq, GREATEST(c.last_seq - p.last_read_seq, 0) AS unread_count, c.last_message_summary, c.last_message_time, c.create_time, CASE WHEN c.status = 'WAITING' THEN c.create_time ELSE NULL END AS waiting_since, COALESCE(c.last_message_time, c.create_time) AS last_active_time, c.closed_time, c.reopen_deadline, c.context_payload, cp.participant_name AS customer_name, cp.participant_avatar AS customer_avatar, sp.participant_name AS assigned_staff_name, sp.participant_avatar AS assigned_staff_avatar, (SELECT pp.last_read_seq FROM message_participant pp WHERE pp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND pp.conversation_id = c.id AND pp.participant_type <> p.participant_type AND pp.participant_status = 'ACTIVE' AND pp.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY pp.joined_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS peer_last_read_seq

LEFT JOIN message_participant cp ON cp.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND cp.conversation_id = c.id AND cp.participant_type = 'MALL_USER' AND cp.participant_id = c.customer_id AND cp.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN message_participant sp ON sp.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND sp.conversation_id = c.id AND sp.participant_type = 'SYS_USER' AND sp.participant_id = c.assigned_staff_id AND sp.participant_status = 'ACTIVE' AND sp.del_flag = '0'

sql.if: AND (c.customer_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR cp.participant_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR c.last_message_summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!')

AND c.status != 'CLOSED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM message_participant up WHERE up.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND up.conversation_id = c.id AND up.participant_type = 'SYS_USER' AND up.participant_status = 'ACTIVE' AND up.del_flag = '0' AND c.last_seq > up.last_read_seq )
AND (COALESCE(c.last_message_time, c.create_time) < #{cursorTime} OR (COALESCE(c.last_message_time, c.create_time) = #{cursorTime} AND c.id < #{cursorId}))

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM message_conversation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_type = 'STAFF_DIRECT' AND staff_pair_key = #{staffPairKey} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'ASSIGNED', 'ACTIVE') AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.conversation_type, c.queue_code, c.customer_id, c.assigned_staff_id, c.status, c.last_seq, c.last_message_summary, c.last_message_time, c.create_time, CASE WHEN c.status = 'WAITING' THEN c.create_time ELSE NULL END AS waiting_since, COALESCE(c.last_message_time, c.create_time) AS last_active_time, c.closed_time, c.reopen_deadline, c.context_payload, cp.participant_name AS customer_name, cp.participant_avatar AS customer_avatar, sp.participant_name AS assigned_staff_name, sp.participant_avatar AS assigned_staff_avatar FROM message_conversation c
WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.id = #{conversationId} AND c.del_flag = '0'

SELECT FROM message_conversation c
WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.del_flag = '0' AND c.status != 'CLOSED' AND c.last_seq > p.last_read_seq ORDER BY COALESCE(c.last_message_time, c.create_time) DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_conversation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_type = 'CUSTOMER_SERVICE' AND queue_code = #{queueCode} AND status = 'WAITING' AND assigned_staff_id IS NULL AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT c.id, c.conversation_type, c.queue_code, c.customer_id, c.assigned_staff_id, c.status, c.last_seq, 0 AS last_read_seq, 0 AS unread_count, c.last_message_summary, c.last_message_time, c.create_time, CASE WHEN c.status = 'WAITING' THEN c.create_time ELSE NULL END AS waiting_since, COALESCE(c.last_message_time, c.create_time) AS last_active_time, c.closed_time, c.reopen_deadline, c.context_payload, cp.participant_name AS customer_name, cp.participant_avatar AS customer_avatar FROM message_conversation c
WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.conversation_type = 'CUSTOMER_SERVICE' AND c.queue_code = #{queueCode} AND c.status = 'WAITING' AND c.assigned_staff_id IS NULL AND c.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY c.create_time ASC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.queue_code, COUNT(*) AS waiting_count, MIN(c.create_time) AS oldest_waiting_since FROM message_conversation c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.conversation_type = 'CUSTOMER_SERVICE' AND c.status = 'WAITING' AND c.assigned_staff_id IS NULL AND c.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY c.queue_code ORDER BY MIN(c.create_time) ASC, c.queue_code ASC

SELECT * FROM message_conversation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_type = 'CUSTOMER_SERVICE' AND status = 'WAITING' AND assigned_staff_id IS NULL AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE message_conversation SET assigned_staff_id = #{staffId}, status = 'ASSIGNED', update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'WAITING' AND assigned_staff_id IS NULL AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE message_conversation SET status = 'WAITING', assigned_staff_id = NULL, closed_time = NULL, reopen_deadline = NULL, close_reason = NULL, update_by = #{customerId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'CLOSED' AND reopen_deadline > NOW() AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM message_conversation WHERE conversation_type = 'CUSTOMER_SERVICE' AND status IN ('WAITING', 'ASSIGNED', 'ACTIVE') AND COALESCE(last_message_time, create_time) < #{inactiveBefore} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_time, create_time) ASC LIMIT #{limit}
